subject.outcomeDefinition: None. This record reports a descriptive index, not a claim about any future or independently observable event. There is no condition that could make it wrong.
subject.resolutionSource: Not applicable. Nothing resolves a descriptive index.

reasons.detail: This is not an abstention for want of evidence. The analyzer produced a complete descriptive index (overall 72/100, all five categories scored, full retrieval). No prediction is being made because the index is a characterisation of the page as observed, not a claim about any independently resolvable outcome. The pack has no output type for this, so abstention is the nearest available shape and it misstates the reason.

baseline.reason: A descriptive index has no reference probability; there is no event whose base rate could be quoted.

sampleSize.basis: The single page under analysis. An index describes one artifact; it is not estimated from a sample.
sampleSize.justification: Sample size is not a meaningful concept for a descriptive index of one artifact.
